title: Phase Brief
description: Required structure for any cross-platform UI initiative phase brief. Enforced by scripts/validate_phase_brief.cr. A brief that does not satisfy this schema is not dispatchable.

invariant_matrix.description: REQUIRED. One row per UI-library invariant (I-1 through I-11). All 11 must be present. See handoff/planning-retrospective-2026-05-22.md for the canonical definitions.

lower_layer_assumptions.description: Every 'we assume X' the brief depends on. Each has a one-line verification command that exits 0 iff X holds.

repo_derived_facts.description: Every numeric count, symbol name, flag convention, file path, or version pin in the brief. Captured by a query at brief-authoring time.

adapter_cardinality.description: OPTIONAL. Required ONLY if the phase binds a public API to an existing native component. Documents cardinality match between API input space and adapter input space. MISMATCH rows require documented_degradation + owner_approved.

pre_dispatch_validation.description: Path to a runnable script that validates this brief end-to-end (re-runs queries, runs verifications, asserts schema completeness). Architect runs before dispatch; exit 0 means dispatchable.

touch.description: preserves = phase doesn't change invariant; cite existing probe. extends = phase adds new surface; new probe required. replaces = phase changes satisfaction mechanism; new probe + old deprecation. skips = phase explicitly does not touch; brief states why.

rationale.description: Why this touch level. Must explain what the phase does to/for this invariant.

probes.description: Per-platform proof commands. For 'preserves', each platform cell may reference an existing probe by path. For 'extends'/'replaces', each cell must be either (a) an executable command string OR (b) a skip object with reason + owner_approved.

oneOf.description: A runnable shell command OR path to a spec/script (e.g., 'spec/ui/foo_spec.cr' or 'crystal-alpha spec spec/ui/foo_spec.cr -Dmacos --link-flags=...').

reason.description: Why this platform/invariant cell is skipped. Must NOT include placeholder strings.

placeholder.description: Reject strings that are placeholders rather than real commands.

claim.description: The assumption made. Concrete, not vague.

falsifier.description: What observable would prove the claim wrong.

verification.description: One-line shell command that exits 0 iff the assumption holds. Must be deterministic.

query.description: Shell command that produces the fact's value.
